text.tspan: On this machine: SHA-256 is 1.16× to 2.17× faster than BLAKE3; BLAKE3 is 1.53× to 3.58× faster than SHA-1DC
BLAKE3 SME2 matches BLAKE3 below 1 KiB and is up to 2.62× faster from there

svg.text: Line and dot: median · shaded band: minimum–maximum across 128 interleaved samples · single-threaded · lower is better

Dot shape marks the code path a contender used at that size; a ringed dot is where a new path begins · hover any dot to compare contenders and see the path · click a name at right to hide or show that contender

g.text: BLAKE3 SME2: source https://github.com/johnservil/BLAKE3 · branch sme2-bench · commit 4ca9952c8522
BLAKE3 SME2: single-threaded; SME2 kernel for groups of sixteen chunks, integer + NEON hybrid kernels below that; the benchmark stops on a CPU without SME2
